basic_info.description: It's walking distance to San Francisco State University. Single story detached cottage in Merced Heights consists of 2 Bedroom/2 Baths (Legality of one bath is not warranted). Convenient location close to transportation, 19th Ave, Junipero Serra, Metro line, Ocean Avenue cafes, Whole Foods, SFSU, Stonetown shopping mall, Lake Merced, scenic bikeways, SF prestigious golf clubs, Lake Merced & HWY 280.  The house has been rental, and seller never occupied. Don't miss out on this opportunity to turn this into your dream home. New roof May 2025.
